ApproverAuthority.title: ApproverAuthority
ApproverAuthority.description: A human approver's limits: the maximum gross amount and the exceptions they may approve.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Idempotency key: one per edit, reused when the edit is retried.

CartEditRequest.title: CartEditRequest
CartEditRequest.description: The customer's own quantity edit on the card: only products already in the cart.

sales_quantity.title: Sales Quantity
sales_quantity.description: Whole sales units (packs) of this product in the basket. 0 leaves the line out of the basket but keeps the product in the cart, so a later value above 0 brings it back.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Idempotency key: one per button press, reused when the press is retried.

CartPurchaseRequest.title: CartPurchaseRequest
CartPurchaseRequest.description: Prepare the order from the conversation's cart without the assistant (a customer button).

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Idempotency key: one per button press, reused when the press is retried.

CartRefreshRequest.title: CartRefreshRequest
CartRefreshRequest.description: Prepare an EXPIRED basket again from the cart, for the same date and destination (a button).

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: Set on a plain notice, not an answer. provider_unavailable: stored when the model provider failed (the unfinished message keeps its retry offer). order_confirmed (role system): one line stored after the customer's confirm placed a demo order, in the customer's language, with the delivery date.

Contribution.title: Contribution
Contribution.description: One ingredient's required quantity inside a basket line (BAS-002, MEA-005).

cart_not_included.title: Cart Not Included
cart_not_included.description: Items the current basket leaves out (no product, no quantity, or removed by the customer on the card), from the latest stored plan; empty without an open basket.

cart_edit_reason.title: Cart Edit Reason
cart_edit_reason.description: Why the number controls on the card are disabled, if they are.

DemoClockAdvance.title: DemoClockAdvance
DemoClockAdvance.description:
Exactly one of `days` (1..30) or `to: "delivery_day"` (06:00 Helsinki on the delivery date
of the earliest undelivered order).

DemoClockState.title: DemoClockState
DemoClockState.description: The buyer's simulated time (demo mode only; the routes answer 404 when it is off).

DraftCart.title: DraftCart
DraftCart.description: Display-only plan projection; never accepted by confirmation or preparation.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: `details` is the list of ErrorDetail for VALIDATION_ERROR; some application errors send an object.

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
ErrorDetail.description: One validation failure. The submitted value is never included.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The one body of every HTTP error response (TCT-008).

Fulfilment.title: Fulfilment
Fulfilment.description:
The SIMULATED fulfilment status of a mock order, derived from its delivery date and a clock.

Never stored and never real: the supplier has no order API (`simulated` is always true). `clock`
says whether the status follows real time or the buyer's demo clock.

purchase_amount.title: Purchase Amount
purchase_amount.description: The REQUIRED amount in the unit the basket uses (a copy of amount, converted to the plan unit). It is not the pack-rounded purchase: see conversion.proposed_amount.

purchase_unit.title: Purchase Unit
purchase_unit.description: Unit of purchase_amount (KG, L or piece). Not the pack or sales unit.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Explicit catalog unit code, L or KG; boxes is ambiguous.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.description: Free-form baskets: the ingredients this line serves; amounts add up to it.

LineRule.title: LineRule
LineRule.description:
Per ingredient (CNF-036, POL-012): the customer's accepted substitutes, chosen from the
candidates the product page offers, and the price range around the agreed unit price.

budget_gross.title: Budget Gross
budget_gross.description: Hard budget in euros, gross; the basket may not exceed it.

MessageConstraints.title: MessageConstraints
MessageConstraints.description: Hard limits the customer sets on a message (POL-008); false withdraws an earlier toggle.

constraints.description: Optional hard limits set by the customer (budget, dietary toggles). They stay in force for the rest of the conversation until a later message changes them.

max_order_gross.title: Max Order Gross
max_order_gross.description: Optional account-wide gross cap per order. Never grants personal approval authority.

approved_product_ids.title: Approved Product Ids
approved_product_ids.description: Buyer-configured product scope. Outside products count as substitutions even without an agent flag. Missing scope always blocks a purchase until an operator configures it.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of this revision's material terms (request, lines, prices, deposits, product facts, currency, mode, charges, policy version and blockers). A customer confirmation is bound to this revision and fingerprint; it excludes lookup time and stock that stays sufficient.

fulfilment.description: The simulated fulfilment status once an order exists, otherwise null.

reason_classes.title: Reason Classes
reason_classes.description: One class per reason code present. blocker: data or the request must change (unresolved or denied). exception: the customer's own confirmation can cover it. warning: shown, blocks nothing. expired: the supplier cutoff has passed and the basket is expired, so it can only be prepared again. Derived for display; it never changes whether a basket can be confirmed.

totals_are_estimates.title: Totals Are Estimates
totals_are_estimates.description: True when any line is priced by variable weight, so the totals are estimates. Absent otherwise.

free_from.title: Free From
free_from.description: Allergen codes (for example AM milk, AE, AW) the product must explicitly declare free from. A product with no declaration is excluded, not assumed safe.

country_of_origin.title: Country Of Origin
country_of_origin.description: Two-letter origin codes (for example fi, se); the product must match one. A product with no recorded origin is excluded.

unsupported.title: Unsupported
unsupported.description: Customer requirements the catalog cannot verify (for example gluten-free). Each entry blocks readiness: the basket needs the customer's decision (POL-009).

RetryConstraints.title: RetryConstraints
RetryConstraints.description: The limits of an unfinished message, in the shape the client sends them back.

RetryMessage.title: RetryMessage
RetryMessage.description: An unfinished message, including the same limits and files for an exact retry.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of this revision's material terms (request, lines, prices, deposits, product facts, currency, mode, charges, policy version and blockers). A customer confirmation is bound to this revision and fingerprint; it excludes lookup time and stock that stays sufficient.

fulfilment.description: The simulated fulfilment status once an order exists, otherwise null.

reason_classes.title: Reason Classes
reason_classes.description: One class per reason code present. blocker: data or the request must change (unresolved or denied). exception: the customer's own confirmation can cover it. warning: shown, blocks nothing. expired: the supplier cutoff has passed and the basket is expired, so it can only be prepared again. Derived for display; it never changes whether a basket can be confirmed.

title.title: Title
title.description: The customer's own name; omitted: derived from the past order

replaced_by.title: Replaced By
replaced_by.description: The schedule that replaced or restarted this one, if any

next_run_date.title: Next Run Date
next_run_date.description: Null once stopped, cancelled or expired

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: The chat of the latest disrupted run, if any

title.title: Title
title.description: Omitted: the schedule keeps its name

ScheduleEditPreviewRequest.title: ScheduleEditPreviewRequest
ScheduleEditPreviewRequest.description: Preview the terms of an existing schedule with optional changes (the edit page).

title.title: Title
title.description: The customer's own name; omitted: derived from the past order

title.title: Title
title.description: Omitted: the schedule keeps its name

ScheduleReplaceRequest.title: ScheduleReplaceRequest
ScheduleReplaceRequest.description: Edit or restart: a new authorization that supersedes the old one.

replaced_by.title: Replaced By
replaced_by.description: The schedule that replaced or restarted this one, if any

next_run_date.title: Next Run Date
next_run_date.description: Null once stopped, cancelled or expired

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: The chat of the latest disrupted run, if any

next_dates.title: Next Dates
next_dates.description: The first scheduled dates, for the preview

ScheduleTerms.title: ScheduleTerms
ScheduleTerms.description: What the customer is asked to agree to; `terms_fingerprint` goes back in create/replace.

price_is_estimate.title: Price Is Estimate
price_is_estimate.description: True for a variable-weight product: the final weight and price settle at delivery (BAS-007). Absent otherwise.
